title: Reloading Sequencer.js replaces a running sequence
summary: Sequencer.js defines 'var indigo_sequencer = {...}' unconditionally (Sequencer.js:758) and clients such as the web UI send the library before every script (indigo_server/resource/indigo.js:198). A client running any script while a sequence, including one started by the Scheduler Agent, executes replaces the singleton and orphans the sequence. Owner deferred Sequencer.js changes on 2026-11-12. Next: keep the existing object while a sequence runs (design: indigo_docs/SCHEDULER.md 'Library reloads').
